decisions.reason: The web-based weir dimensioning tool still fits the firm's engineering-planner customer base, is inexpensive to keep available, and its option value as a digital lead-in to projects likely exceeds its carrying cost.
The spring-controlled flap weir is close to the established water-infrastructure offering, and after only one year on the market the uncertainty about demand is still too high to justify abandonment.

The energy management system is strongly aligned with the firm's strategic move toward digitally networked, efficient and energy-aware infrastructure, so management would keep this option open despite early-stage uncertainty.

The overflow flap gate appears to be a committed product line with several models and strong overlap with existing customers and capabilities, making continued market presence the more valuable choice for now.
